actions.sourceText: The intelligent navigation assistance (NOA) function can independently plan the route on the expressway and some urban expressways according to the navigation destination set by the user, and automatically change lanes according to the route, automatically get on and off the ramp, drive according to the speed limit of the road, intelligently surpass slow cars or avoid large cars. The Intelligent Navigation Assistance (NOA) function is a comfort assistant driving function, which cannot cope with all risk scenarios. In some emergency situations, the driver needs to take over. This system is not automatic driving. It can only assist the driver to complete some driving tasks in limited scenarios, and cannot replace the driver to drive, let alone judge the road conditions. In any case, it is the primary responsibility of the driver to ensure driving safety. The driver should always focus on observing the traffic environment and the operation of the vehicle, hold the steering wheel all the way, and be ready to take over the vehicle at any time. Other precautions: \n(1) When the function is activated, the driver actively steps on the accelerator pedal to accelerate. If there is an obstacle in front of the driver, the pilot driving aid cannot automatically decelerate. \n(2) It is not recommended to use this system in special situations such as heavy fog, rainy and snowy days, night, turning, intersection, tunnel, confluence and close cut of vehicles ahead.
